signature: def authorize(self, customer: Customer, amount_cents: int) -> PaymentReceipt:
summary: Authorize a payment by validating the amount, debiting the customer, updating the authorized total, and returning a new payment receipt.
inputs: customer (Customer): Customer account to be debited; must support <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.models.Customer.debit</SPL>.
amount_cents (int): Positive amount in cents to authorize.
self.provider (Provider): Provider identifier read from instance state and included in <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.payments.PaymentReceipt</SPL>.
outputs: receipt (PaymentReceipt): A new <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.payments.PaymentReceipt</SPL> constructed with a generated UUID string, amount_cents, and self.provider.
self.authorized_total_cents (int): Instance state incremented by amount_cents.
customer_balance (mutation): Side effect: customer.debit(amount_cents) invoked to reduce available funds on the customer.
main_effect: Generate a new UUID string via uuid4() and construct <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.payments.PaymentReceipt</SPL> with (id, amount_cents, self.provider); return it.
side_effects: customer_balance (mutation): Side effect: customer.debit(amount_cents) invoked to reduce available funds on the customer.
receipt (PaymentReceipt): A new <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.payments.PaymentReceipt</SPL> constructed with a generated UUID string, amount_cents, and self.provider.
self.authorized_total_cents (int): Instance state incremented by amount_cents.
errors: <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.payments.PaymentError</SPL>: Raised with message 'amount must be positive' when the amount is not greater than zero.
<SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.payments.PaymentError</SPL>: Re-raised as PaymentError with the original ValueError message.
